architecture: stateless AbsentPorts BusDevice per region (Cmos: 2 ports, IoDelay: 1 port), each behind one PortRegionBinding; not wired into the firmware board

width_policy.device: byte only; word/dword/qword = UnsupportedWidth; MMIO = UnsupportedSpace; offset past binding = UnknownOffset
width_policy.bus: word@0x70 reaches device (UnsupportedWidth); dword@0x70, word/dword@0x71, word/dword@0xED = CrossesRegion; qword = UnsupportedWidth
width_policy.reason: model-wide PIO policy (8259/UART/conf1 refuse, not invent); Linux uses only inb/outb here

fadt_link.test: model_agrees_with_the_fadt_iapc_boot_arch (committed ACPI blob bytes + firmware constant text)

injections.change: 0x71 stores the written byte and reads it back
